# Overview {.unnumbered}

This book collects exploratory analyses, method benchmarks, and drafts for the
**MPN 10x Camélia** project. Nothing here is guaranteed to end up in the final
pipeline — it's a working space for thinking through alternatives.

## What lives here

| Chapter | Purpose |
|---|---|
| QC exploration | Parameter sweeps for filtering thresholds |
| Demultiplex (pre-QC) | HTO demultiplexing exploration before cell filtering |
| Demultiplex (post-QC) | HTO class distribution after QC flags applied |
| Dim reduction & clustering | Resolution scans, batch factor and k sweeps, UMAP flavours |
| PCA GSEA | Gene set enrichment on PCA loadings |
| Marker benchmarks | FindAllMarkers settings, presto vs wilcox timing |
| Cell cycle | Scoring strategies, regression trade-offs |

## What lives elsewhere

- **`_targets.R`** — the production R pipeline
- **`pipeline.py`** — the production Python pipeline
- **`analysis/analysis.qmd`** — the final report rendered by the pipeline

## Setup

Notebooks load all data via `targets::tar_load()` from the targets store.
A complete pipeline run (`tar_make()`) must be done before rendering.

```r
library(targets)
```
